summary: Three strong-value used SUVs (2020 or newer, ≤~40 k mi) active in the Philadelphia–South Jersey–Central NJ region: 2020 Toyota RAV4 LE AWD (~53 k mi at CarMax Langhorne, fee-inclusive $24,998), 2022 Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD (~30 k mi at Davis Acura, fee-inclusive $26,218), and 2022 Subaru Forester Wilderness (~30 k mi at Ardmore Toyota, fee-inclusive $25,934). All offer solid reliability and value; Hybrid models not included this round. VINs incomplete — buyer should verify history and confirm availability.

trimComparisons.comparison: Wilderness adds higher ground clearance (9.2 in vs 8.7), more rugged off‑road capability, but sacrifices roughly 3 mpg combined vs Premium (26 vs 29 mpg) and has slightly less cargo capacity with moonroof; Wilderness is better for rougher terrain, Premium is more efficient and refined.

vehicles.notes: Low‑mileage 2020 RAV4 with strong reliability at competitive CarMax price; under 40k mi target exceeded but still valuable.
